Markets.title: Alcohol stocks jump as blue wave boosts industry prospects
Markets.summary: Alcohol stocks rose during the midterm elections as investors anticipated favorable immigration policies and easing trade tensions with Canada. However, looming tariffs caused a sharp decline in US spirits exports.

Markets.title: Musk stocks lose $120 billion as Democrats’ Texas win rattles investors
Markets.summary: Tesla and SpaceX lost over $120 billion in combined market value following major Democratic election victories in Texas and nationwide. Investors fear that a Democrat-controlled Congress will increase regulatory hurdles and scrutiny for Elon Musk's companies.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rebounds with stocks despite threat to crypto agenda
Markets.summary: Bitcoin rebounded over 4% to surpass $81,000, following a broader market recovery after the US midterm elections. However, Democratic control of Congress poses risks to crypto legislation and increases regulatory scrutiny.

Markets.title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections
Markets.summary: AI data center stocks fell following the Democratic congressional sweep in the US midterm elections due to concerns over tighter oversight. Conversely, renewable energy and healthcare shares surged as investors anticipated continued clean energy support.

Markets.title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
Markets.summary: The US Treasury updated its regulations to suggest potential increases in short- and intermediate-term debt issuance. It also flagged declining demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions, with future adjustments depending on financial needs and market trends.

Markets.title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
Markets.summary: Meta Platforms received €53 billion in orders for its debut euro bond issuance to raise €9 billion across six parts. This follows the company's recent $15 billion bond offering in the United States.

Geo-Political.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
Geo-Political.summary: Angry Republicans blamed Donald Trump for their defeat in the midterm elections. They stated that his focus on his own legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost the party the election.

Geo-Political.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
Geo-Political.summary: The Democratic victory in the US midterm elections increases pressure on the White House to reach a trade deal with Canada. This political shift renews Canadian hopes for relief from US tariffs as bilateral trade talks resume.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv states that bodycam footage proves Russia carried out a deadly double-tap bombing on a Ukrainian village on Monday. The attack killed at least 40 people, and approximately 30 others may still be trapped under the rubble.

Geo-Political.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
Geo-Political.summary: Hackers compromised cold storage rooms used by the French Blood Establishment to preserve blood supplies. Authorities are currently investigating potential culprits behind the cyberattacks.

Geo-Political.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
Geo-Political.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono issued a statement expressing profound sorrow following the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel. Owono described this tragedy as the most difficult period of his life.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli President Herzog has started consulting with political parties to break the country's recent election deadlock. He warned politicians that they must compromise on some of their commitments if they want to avoid holding yet another election.

Data & Insights.title: Trump's midterm setback may give India an edge in trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: Despite the Republican midterm election defeat, the US embassy stated that President Donald Trump remains in control of Washington's trade agenda. This assurance aims to alleviate concerns that the election setback might derail ongoing trade negotiations with India.

Data & Insights.title: Explained: Why could a weak monsoon derail India's ambitious ethanol blending programme?
Data & Insights.summary: India's weak monsoon and rising food prices are prioritizing food security over ethanol production. This shift could cause India to miss its 20% fuel-blending target and increase its reliance on imported crude oil.

Data & Insights.title: LTCG tax relief on cards? FM acknowledges FPI concerns as SEBI, FICCI push for reforms in Budget 2027
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman acknowledged rising foreign investment outflows and investor concerns regarding India's market climate. She stated the government will consider feedback on reforms as it aims to sustain growth near 7%.

Data & Insights.title: India sees some trade relief, new risks after US midterm vote
Data & Insights.summary: The recent US midterm election results have weakened President Trump's political position, giving India more breathing room in ongoing trade negotiations. This political shift reduces pressure on New Delhi to accept trade terms it considers unfavorable, though new risks have also emerged.

Data & Insights.title: Services sector growth hits a four-month peak in October, PMI survey shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's services sector growth reached a four-month high in October, driven by strong domestic demand. During this period, HSBC's India Services PMI rose to 55.8 as cost pressures fell to a six-year low, despite slower export orders and hiring.

Data & Insights.title: Geographical branding revolutionized French champagne; are GI tags working for India, too?
Data & Insights.summary: India is increasingly granting Geographical Indication (GI) tags to products unique to specific regions, following the model of French champagne. While some of these geographical branding efforts have succeeded, others still need to unlock their full potential.

India.title: Vijay Says Meeting With School Toppers In Chennai Not About Politics
India.summary: Actor Vijay stated that his meeting with school toppers in Chennai was not political. The event followed Madras High Court criticism regarding his party using children in political campaigns.

India.title: How US Polls Can Change The World For Trump: Foreign Policy Editor Explains
India.summary: Foreign Policy Editor Ravi Agrawal explains that global leaders and corporations monitor the political strength of U.S. figures. Consequently, these international actors will adjust their diplomatic and business strategies when dealing with a weakened Trump administration.

India.title: "Could Smell Alcohol On Him": Rahul Gandhi Attacks Bhagwant Mann, AAP Reacts
India.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann by implying he was intoxicated and lacked commitment to solving the state's drug crisis. The Aam Aadmi Party reacted to the attack, though specific details of their response were not in the provided text.

India.title: Man Accuses Wife, Mother-In-Law Of Forced Circumcision In Assam
India.summary: Akhil Kumar Chandak filed a police report in Assam accusing his wife and mother-in-law of forcing him to undergo circumcision. The complaint names 24-year-old Nurshika Begum and 36-year-old Nur Khatun at the Bhangagarh Police Station.

India.title: 4 Militants Killed As Rival Groups Clash In Manipur Village
India.summary: Four militants died in a clash between rival groups at Taodaizing village in Manipur on Wednesday. Three of the dead belonged to the Zeliangrong United Front's Jenchui faction, while the fourth was a member of the National Socialist Council of Nagalim.

India.title: 6 Arrested by Assam Police In Fraud Case, Pak Link Under Scanner
India.summary: Assam Police arrested six people in connection with a fraud case involving a cross-border financial syndicate. Authorities are currently investigating potential links to Pakistan.

General.title: Bowen: Trump's loss limits powers at home, but it will likely be different abroad
General.summary: Following midterms losses that limit his domestic powers, President Trump will likely focus on exerting his influence abroad. The BBC's international editor reports that Trump will want to show he can still shake the world despite these setbacks.
